items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer lists 'Guy Jackson' among 'guys that I played with' and asks 'Did you ever hear of him?' Interviewee responds 'No.'

ctx.x: That was a nice little band. We used to play a little Classical music for the luncheon, you know, for the business section. We played nice, things like that. Then in the evening, when they danced, you know, we would stretch out a little bit. I'm trying to think who this guy was who played piano. I can't think of his name.

There were so many guys down through the years. Jesus! It would be impossible for me to think of the guys that I played with. Let's see. Alvin Burroughs. Chuck. [INAUDIBLE NAME] Charlie Lee, he's another tenor player that was good. Hen-Pie. Guy Jackson. Did you ever hear of him?
